difficulty_reason: For a commutative diagram X -> Y -> S of schemes with Y -> S smooth and X -> S perfect, the lemma concludes f : X -> Y is perfect. The retained proof is written as the standard graph-factorization: f factors as X -> X x_S Y -> Y where the first map is the graph i = (1, f) and the second the projection; the projection is perfect because it is the base change of the perfect map X -> S along the flat (smooth) map Y -> S (chapter lemma flat-base-change-perfect plus Morphisms, lemma smooth-flat); the graph i is a section of the smooth projection X x_S Y -> X (base-change of Y -> S, Morphisms, lemma base-change-smooth), hence a regular immersion (Divisors, lemma section-smooth-regular-immersion), hence perfect (chapter lemma regular-immersion-perfect, queued next); composition of perfect morphisms (chapter lemma composition-perfect) closes. Retained author proof at lines 17846-17866.
